name: Last ZZ50
summary: This EA trades based on ZigZag indicator signals, identifying swing highs and lows to determine trend direction and enter positions at reversal points. The 'ZZ50' likely refers to a ZigZag with a 50-pip or 50-point depth parameter for filtering minor price movements. It opens buy positions at ZigZag lows and sell positions at ZigZag highs, aiming to catch trend reversals and ride the new trend.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ZigZag指标信号进行交易，通过识别摆动高低点来判断趋势方向并在反转点入场。'ZZ50'可能指深度参数为50点或50个点的ZigZag指标，用于过滤小幅价格波动。它在ZigZag低点开多单，在ZigZag高点开空单，旨在捕捉趋势反转并跟随新趋势运行。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ZigZag指标的摆动点识别，当ZigZag确认新的低点形成时开多单，当确认新的高点形成时开空单。入场条件依赖ZigZag指标完成一个摆动点的确认，这需要价格回撤超过设定的深度阈值（50点/点）。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损或等待下一个ZigZag摆动点形成后平仓。仓位管理方面，从文件名无法确定是否包含动态手数计算，可能使用固定手数。资金管理方面，缺乏明确的资金管理机制是该类EA的常见问题，仅依赖ZigZag信号本身而不考虑账户风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on ZigZag indicator swing point identification, opening long positions when a new ZigZag low is confirmed and short positions when a new ZigZag high is confirmed. Entry conditions rely on the ZigZag indicator completing a swing point confirmation, which requires price to retrace beyond the configured depth threshold (50 points/pips). Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or waiting for the next ZigZag swing point to form before closing. Position sizing is unclear from the filename alone but likely uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic calculation based on account equity. Money management is a common weakness in ZigZag-based EAs as they typically rely solely on the indicator signal without considering overall account risk exposure or drawdown limits.

parameters.name: ZigZag Depth
parameters.description: ZigZag指标深度参数，过滤小幅波动的阈值
parameters.description_en: ZigZag depth parameter filtering minor fluctuations

pros: ZigZag指标能有效识别市场关键转折点，过滤噪音
基于结构性的趋势反转交易，逻辑清晰易懂
深度参数可调，适应不同市场波动环境
pros_en: ZigZag effectively identifies key market turning points and filters noise
Structural trend reversal trading with clear and understandable logic
Adjustable depth parameter adapts to different market volatility environments
cons: ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，已形成的摆动点可能被修改，导致信号不可靠
缺乏明确的资金管理和仓位控制机制
无止损或止损设置不足可能导致较大亏损
在震荡行情中频繁产生错误信号
cons_en: ZigZag indicator has repainting behavior - confirmed swing points can be modified, making signals unreliable
Lacks explicit money management and position control mechanisms
Missing or insufficient stop-loss can lead to significant losses
Generates frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets
improvements: 添加止损止盈机制和资金管理模块，根据账户余额动态计算手数
结合其他指标（如RSI或MACD）过滤ZigZag信号，减少假信号
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，避免重复交易和高成本入场
improvements_en: Add stop-loss/take-profit mechanisms and money management module with dynamic lot calculation based on account balance
Combine with additional indicators (e.g., RSI or MACD) to filter ZigZag signals and reduce false entries
Add new bar check and spread filter to avoid repeated trades and high-cost entries

risk_points: ZigZag指标重绘问题可能导致回测与实盘表现严重不一致
缺乏止损机制时单笔亏损可能超出预期
risk_points_en: ZigZag repainting issue can cause significant discrepancy between backtest and live performance
Single trade loss may exceed expectations when stop-loss mechanism is absent
